predictions.prediction_text: Upside volatility will remain sticky and rangebound under negative gamma, with volatility-of-volatility stabilizing lower.
predictions.expected_result: Implied and realized upside volatility stay elevated relative to downside but show limited directional expansion; vol-of-volatility measures decline or flatten over the next sessions.

predictions.prediction_text: If only dealer flows dominate, upward spot moves will be slowed and upward ranges compressed as dealers sell into the rally due to long-gamma exposure.
predictions.condition: dealer flows are the primary market driver
predictions.expected_result: During spot rallies, price momentum weakens and intraday/upside range size contracts versus prior sessions, coinciding with net selling by dealers.

predictions.prediction_text: If spot moves down while dealers are short gamma, downside moves will face less resistance and ranges can expand, producing spot down with rising volatility.
predictions.expected_result: Downward price moves accelerate with larger intraday ranges and an increase in implied and realized volatility during declines.

predictions.prediction_text: If buying flow comes from positive vanna hedging while momentum declines, intraday implied volatility in that tenor will fall.
predictions.condition: buying flow from positive vanna hedging and intraday momentum declines
predictions.expected_result: Implied volatility for the affected tenor decreases intraday alongside falling momentum.
